mechanism_lane.primary_invariant: authoritative resting sell quantity never exceeds authoritative held quantity
required_checks: Replay both heal-then-topup and topup-then-heal orderings.
Replay at least two consecutive reconcile cycles.
Prove each ordering converges to one five-lot resting exit for five held.
Prove the D2 clamp reads positions and resting sells immediately before every sell POST.
Prove attempted excess is refused, receipted, alerted, and never submitted.
Prove booked quantity > 0 plus unsettled holding is required for filled.
mechanism_lane.required_result: resting_sell_qty <= held_qty for every replay tick and final resting_sell_qty == held_qty where coverage is required

classifier_lane.primary_invariant: zero false pair-incomplete flags from stale, zero-booked, resting-only, or settled states
classifier_lane.required_result: zero false filled states and zero false pair-incomplete flags

live_observation_after_future_authorized.window: post-boot audit plus at least two complete reconcile cycles
collect: authoritative held and resting-sell quantities per ticker
pair-incomplete classifications with booked and unsettled quantities

market_pnl_claim: not applicable; this is a safety invariant repair, not a strategy outcome claim
